title: Implement local-command LLM provider healthchecks

context.summary: Make local-command provider healthchecks real for every configured model role.
context.background: The model SDK must validate command executables, role support and model readiness before runtime operations use them.

in: Define the local-command healthcheck JSON contract.
Validate executable path, arguments, timeout, role and model.
Record healthcheck audit events with status, duration and diagnostics.
Add tests for success, timeout, malformed JSON and unsupported role responses.
Remove TASK-96-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: local-command healthchecks execute real commands with timeout and JSON parsing.
Health results validate role and model compatibility.
Failures produce structured diagnostics and audit entries.
Installer can use the healthcheck contract for configured local-command roles.

manual_checks: Confirm no local-command healthcheck not-implemented marker remains.

risks: Command execution must not leak secrets in audit logs.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
